Question: What is the main problem solved by using a database instead of an in-memory collection?
Options: A. It makes C# code shorter
B. It prevents the application from restarting
C. It allows data to persist after the application stops
D. It removes the need for MVC
CorrectAnswer: C. It allows data to persist after the application stops

Question: Which approach is being used when an existing database is used to generate EF Core entity classes?
What is the primary purpose of Entity Framework Core?
Options: A. To create HTML pages automatically
B. To replace the MVC Controller
C. To map objects in code to relational database data
D. To replace the C# compiler
CorrectAnswer: C. To map objects in code to relational database data

Question: Which EF Core component is primarily responsible for communicating with the database?
What does the following command primarily do? dotnet ef dbcontext scaffold "ConnectionString" Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.SqlServer -o Models
Options: B. Creates a new MVC project
C. Generates EF Core models and a DbContext from an existing database
CorrectAnswer: C. Generates EF Core models and a DbContext from an existing database
